arc.opening: You mentioned a porch swing your grandfather built.

turns.text: You mentioned a porch swing your grandfather built. What's one evening on it that's stuck with you?
The chains used to squeak in this specific rhythm, and my grandmother would hum along with it without even noticing.
Chains that squeaked in a rhythm your grandmother hummed along to without noticing — that's such a particular kind of harmony. Tell me more about "this specific rhythm".
It was almost a lullaby by the end of most summers. I still catch myself humming it.

A squeak that turned into a lullaby your grandmother hummed without knowing, and you still catch yourself humming it too — that's the whole porch in one sound. I'll keep it filed next to the chains and that hum.

annotations.takeaway: A squeak that turned into a lullaby your grandmother hummed without knowing, and you still catch yourself humming it too.
annotations.hook: filed next to the chains and that hum
